base.name: Cowork Funchal, Rua das Mercês 41, 3rd floor (sea-facing)

antennas: dual-attach per board: 868 whip on sub-GHz jack (Pin 9) + 2.4G ~31mm whip on 2.4GHz jack (Pin 10), SMA, no mid-run swap
t0_rule: next 5-min epoch boundary (BOUNDARY_S=300), RX joins before TX, T0 relayed via Signal

Avenida do Mar / Rua do Gomes (port area)

NNE of base, north window at RX

notes: Logs land in firmware/e80-stm32-bench/{tx,rx}-log.csv — copy per stop, commit+push after each stop.
